verification.notes: The legacy false result reversed the meaning of the transcript. Owens said Weiss founded and held a stake in The Free Press before going on to CBS News. The Free Press identifies Weiss as its founder; CBS and AP report that Paramount acquired the outlet founded in 2021 and, as part of that October 2025 transaction, Weiss moved from co-founder/CEO to editor-in-chief of CBS News. The sequence asserted in the episode is therefore true. The erroneous legacy determination remains preserved in legacy_claim_provenance.
